classification: Bounded closing checks on the current review branch: real two-account shared-browser run, keyboard pass on the changed surfaces, and a complete staged Windows installer run. One installer defect confirmed and corrected. Whole-program acceptance remains incomplete.

shared_browser.method: Review image built from the current source and run on a loopback port against a clone of the populated capture database; two seeded synthetic accounts (administrator, then member) signed in one after the other in one Chromium profile through the real sign-in and sign-out controls.
observed: Administrator on the VR page: no service worker registration, no controller, no Cache Storage entries.
After sign-out through the account menu: still none; the VR route redirects to sign-in and an API request is redirected.

Member afterwards: none; the command palette lists navigation only, with no recent-title group and no seeded title names; local storage holds only interface preferences and a session-boundary marker that changes per sign-in.
limits: The seed has no VR-tagged games, so the VR list was empty and no private library data existed to be cached.
No legacy worker was present to retire; R2014 covers retirement synthetically.
One Chromium-based browser on Windows; no headset and no deployed instance.
A session-storage entry of generic Discover zone text survived sign-out; it contained no title names. Not classified as a defect.
shared_browser.earlier_evidence: FE-007 already has real two-account browser evidence in R2035, R2037 and R2038.

keyboard_pass.method: Keyboard only in the same instance; focus order recorded from focus events.
observed: API tokens: name, preset, Create token and session controls are reached in order with a visible 2px focus outline. Creating a token announces a status message.

Revoke confirmation: a labelled and described modal dialog; initial focus on the safe choice; Tab stays inside across repeated cycles; Escape closes it, returns focus to Revoke and leaves the token in place.

Report form: every field has a label and is reached in order. With the GitHub option ticked and no destination configured, the action is named as a preview and the page announces that forwarding is unavailable; nothing is sent.

Mobile navigation at 375px: inert and hidden from assistive technology when closed; opening moves focus to Close and makes the main region inert; focus stays in the navigation across 45 Tab presses; Escape closes it and returns focus to the toggle.
limits: No screen reader or other assistive technology.
The report preview with a configured destination was not exercised; R2032 covers it with a synthetic destination.
Only surfaces changed by this remediation; not a whole-application review.

windows_installer.confirmed_defect: In Windows PowerShell 5.1 the installer's Python version check passed a single-quoted argument containing double quotes to python.exe. That shell drops the embedded quotes, Python raised a SyntaxError, and the installer stopped at its first prerequisite step. The earlier staged run did not show this because Python was reached through a command wrapper.
windows_installer.correction: Commit 7c6695ea uses single quotes inside the Python source. Two regressions failed first: a quoting rule for every inline Python call, and an execution of those calls in Windows PowerShell.
